title: The Local Distance Network: A community consensus report on the measurement of the Hubble constant at ∼1% precision
summary: A community combination of local distance indicators into one network with shared calibrations. Baseline H0 = 73.50 ± 0.81: 7.1σ from Planck+SPT+ACT ΛCDM and 5.0σ from BBN + DESI DR2 BAO.
